entities.name: Alsoor
entities.description: An inland city-state, one of the twelve Southern City-States of the Dark Age of Terisiare, home of Primata Delphine.

entities.name: Delphine
entities.description: Primata of Alsoor who planted rumors to arrest Sima.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Arrested and brought to Alsoor, escaped with the Rag Man's help.

entities.name: Voska
entities.description: Sacrificed himself to draw the Church of Tal away from Jodah.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: Church whose attention Voska drew away.

entities.name: Sima
entities.description: Arrested in Alsoor on the false rumor Voska lived.

entities.name: Battle of Pitdown
entities.description: Battle resulting from the war between Alsoor and Ghed.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Source who said Alsoor was troubled by addictive drugs.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: Land that later took Alsoor's territory.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: Territory later including Alsoor's land after the Thaw.
